description: This module provides helper functions for interacting with TMX data, including fetching ETFs, companies, indices, options, historical prices, and company filings. It contains constants for indices and auxiliary functions for data processing, caching, and HTTP requests.

methods.name: str get_random_agent()
methods.description: Generates a random user agent string using the UserAgent library.

methods.name: get_companies_backend()
methods.description: Initializes and returns an SQLiteBackend for TMX company data cache.

methods.name: get_indices_backend()
methods.description: Initializes and returns an SQLiteBackend for TMX indices data cache.

methods.name: response_callback(response, _: Any)
methods.description: Processes HTTP responses based on content type, returning JSON, text, or raw bytes.

methods.name: Any get_data_from_url( url: str, use_cache: bool = True, backend: Optional["SQLiteBackend"] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Performs an async HTTP GET request, optionally using cache, and returns the response data.

methods.name: Any get_data_from_gql(url: str, headers, data, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Performs an async GraphQL request to a given URL with headers and payload.

methods.name: replace_values_in_list_of_dicts(data)
methods.description: Recursively replaces 'NA' and '-' with None in a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: str check_weekday(date)
methods.description: Checks if a date is a weekday; if not, returns the next weekday's date.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_all_etfs(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of all TMX ETFs with details, caching the JSON response.

methods.name: Dict get_tmx_tickers( exchange: Literal["tsx", "tsxv"] = "tsx", use_cache: bool = True )
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of ticker symbols and company names for specified exchange (tsx or tsxv).

methods.name: Dict get_all_tmx_companies(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Combines TSX and TSX-V listings into a single dict of ticker: name pairs.

methods.name: "DataFrame" get_all_options_tickers(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Fetches options tickers and underlying symbols, returning a DataFrame.

methods.name: "DataFrame" get_current_options(symbol: str, use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves current options chain data for a given symbol as a DataFrame.

methods.name: "DataFrame" download_eod_chains( symbol: str, date: Optional[dateType] = None, use_cache: bool = False )
methods.description: Downloads end-of-day options data for a specific symbol and date.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_company_filings( symbol: str, start_date: Optional[str] = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime( "%Y-%m-%d" ), end_date: Optional[str] = datetime.now().date().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), limit: int = 50, )
methods.description: Fetches recent filings for a specified company symbol.

methods.name: get_daily_price_history( symbol: str, start_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, end_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, adjustment: Literal[ "splits_only", "unadjusted", "splits_and_dividends" ] = "splits_only", )
methods.description: Retrieves historical daily price data over multiple chunks to handle large date ranges.

methods.name: get_weekly_or_monthly_price_history( symbol: str, start_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, end_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, interval: Literal["month", "week"] = "month", )
methods.description: Fetches weekly or monthly historical prices for a symbol.

methods.name: get_intraday_price_history( symbol: str, start_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, end_date: Optional[Union[str, dateType]] = None, interval: Optional[int] = 1, )
methods.description: Fetches intraday price data in chunks using start and end timestamps, adjusting for market hours.

methods.name: "DataFrame" get_all_bonds(use_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Downloads and processes a list of all bonds provided by CIRO with type conversions.

methods.name: create_task(start, end, results)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: try_again()
methods.description: unavailable
